output.text:
Three findings match your complaint “Reads are slow” plus reliability. I’ll fix each in one go:

1. Add a load balancer for the Web app → Catalog API so traffic spreads and there’s no single entry point. Connect it as async (client-initiated).
2. Add a cache next to Catalog API and connect it so reads hit the cache first, reducing Postgres load and latency.
3. Add a read replica of Postgres and connect Catalog API to it for reads; only writes go to the primary. This avoids overloading the single copy.
